constructionBands._note: Cut points measured from the simulated Chaos roster population. Regenerate with npm run chaos:calibrate.

constructionBlurbs.PERFECT STORM: Everything fits. This roster has no obvious way in.
constructionBlurbs.ELITE BUILD: A rare fit — strengths that reinforce each other.
constructionBlurbs.STRONG BUILD: Coherent, with one seam an opponent can work.
constructionBlurbs.COMPETITIVE: A workable five with real strengths and real holes.
constructionBlurbs.VOLATILE: High ceiling, low floor — this can win big or lose badly.
constructionBlurbs.FRAGILE: Great players, but important weaknesses an opponent can exploit.

separation: Talent, Roster Construction and Matchup Fit are three separate concepts and are never collapsed into one number.
